00029220.name: main
00029220._why: Confirmed against 0004df4c: PUSH [0006a3b8] / PUSH [0006a3b4] / CALL / ADD ESP,8, so cdecl right-to-left gives arg1=[0006a3b4]=_argc, arg2=[0006a3b8]=_argv. The only unprefixed name allowed by rebuild_info/naming.md.

00042e0f.name: crt_exit
00042e0f._why: Argument read from [ESP+4], plain RET, caller does ADD ESP,4 -- caller-cleaned cdecl, not the __watcall default. Tail-calls into the DOS terminate path so the trailing RET is unreachable.

00043298.name: crt_cstart
00043298._why: Keeps the entry-point symbol name. Ghidra's six-parameter __watcall signature is an artefact of folding the jump target into a 2-byte stub; it takes nothing and never returns.

00043310.name: crt_cstart_body
00043310._why: Two agents both proposed crt_cstart for 00043298 and 00043310. They are one contiguous piece of cstrt386.asm split only by the embedded copyright banner, so the entry symbol keeps crt_cstart and the startup body after the banner gets crt_cstart_body.
00043310.plate_prefix:
Named crt_cstart_body rather than crt_cstart because the LE entry symbol at
00043298 owns that name; the two are one piece of assembly separated only by
the banner data the linker embeds between them.

00043c82.name: crt_init_delay
00043c82._why: Never the target of a CALL: reached through the runtime init table at 000638f0, so void(void) with no register arguments a wrong signature could invent.

0004df4c.name: crt_cmain
0004df4c._why: Zero parameters, no stack purge, compatible with the __watcall default. Control leaves through exit, so the epilogue is unreachable.

0004dfa6.name: crt_init_rtns
0004dfa6._why: Single argument arrives in EAX (only AL used) and the startup code passes 0xff. __watcall places one integer argument in EAX, which matches.

0004e692.name: crt_stackavail
0004e692._why: MOV EAX,ESP / SUB EAX,[00060430] / RET. No arguments, result in EAX, every caller treats it as unsigned.

00054dbc.name: crt_common_init
00054dbc._why: This function's own agent could only name it descriptively (crt_init_amblksiz, medium confidence, open question about the upstream symbol). The agent on 0004df4c read __CMain's extern order from library module cmain386 -- __ASTACKSIZ, stackavail, __ASTACKPTR, __CommonInit, ___Argv, ___Argc, main, exit -- which fixes the fourth call as __CommonInit. Naming it after the library routine rather than after its one visible side effect settles that open question.
00054dbc.plate_prefix:
Watcom CRT __CommonInit, identified by position in __CMain's extern order
(__ASTACKSIZ, stackavail, __ASTACKPTR, __CommonInit, ___Argv, ___Argc, main,
exit) rather than by its body, which shows only the _amblksiz store below.
